title: Review causal fiber certificate and retained capacity
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds an external written review of [Nick Petalas #6594](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6594), pinned to `2502a6defbe0e78d7f9285c5eb1ff88146a968ab`. No material gap was found in the conditional implication from its actual certificate predicates to a simultaneous binary family at every admitted width, and then to the exact recovery-capacity conclusion.

The review binds the classifier versus signed-half erasure checks, static active labels, silent ADD reads and unchanged destinations, fixed seeds, declared native read sets and zero preservation, event/cut indexing, complete retained-state counting and finite dirty-bank cancellation. The latter requires a finite positive state count, an unrestricted product domain and recovery of the old bank. The family residue code is a written construction; the verifier does not implement its encoder/decoder. Silent ADD residues can still carry information, so no free deletion of other records follows.

**Original whole-word membership and all numerical outcomes remain source-owned and unreplayed.** This does not newly establish the 60 fields, 39 reads, cut10448 or 120N floor. It does not strengthen #6547's different every-seed86N statement, optimize #6546's full record, prove multiplication-entrance reachability or price physical memory.

## Task and overlap

[Advance claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19430405). Canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, eight guidance pins, revision8 and selected6030 were refreshed for the round and before publication. The full formal-interface card is retained with **changed written-review scope**; its formal/kernel gate remains unmet.

Checked the live Hub/index, 703 complete open/draft bodies and heads across eight pages, targeted all-state searches and the source timeline. The final refresh had no metadata/head/body changes. #6547's seed quantifier, #6751's constructive inverse review and #6752's archive are distinct. Sparse local, hidden and unindexed coverage remains unknown; absence of a search hit is not a novelty proof. Prior results are excluded.

## Validation

[Exact review, source texts and sealed roles](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/tree/97dfa98b90982da88945f17dfaffed3e5f3f6991/research/causal-fiber-capacity-review). REVIEW is14,303bytes, SHA256 `04c6f61ef6bd54bbd7732e951bfde861a22e3099f7938707f20a9d2b28afb775`. Target-known abstract and source-aware code drafts were sealed before peer reading, followed by source cross-binding and exact-version assessment. Historical source/preclaim exposure is disclosed. Nine/eight overlapping written controls are **UNEXECUTED**, not17 experiments. A finite-positive-Q clarification was incorporated before freeze; first drafts and seals are unchanged.

All21 files froze at01:35:03.030809UTC. Six exact source objects total59,214bytes; foreign Git custody is separated from ten canonical provenance pins. Committed/public bytes, modes, sole canonical parent, full card and unchanged selected record passed. A separate byte role passed88 checks, with prior abstract/cross involvement disclosed. The complete22-member184,320-byte manual export passed full readback, SHA256 `1ec33a3d8bf440e0e2e8e449bdd02bbdd2ce365f3c24159c296bb25f47f32f9c`. Upstream path/blob/mode locators and two plaintext hashes were checked; compressed WORD bytes/SHA were not read. This inert subset is not the original runnable suite.

Original [CI run42145102876](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42145102876), attempt1, passed:711 helper tests,24 skips, Python3.12.16. Scientific replay was skipped with **zero commands**. Its checkout tree and canonical/public parents match the exact publication; no repository merge or mathematical acceptance is implied. The169,450-byte plan log was downloaded once and fully reread, SHA256 `a351ba025cc906aee5d23b7685742bb8551d3ec81b6d8f7d1b4eb7c10192fe25`. At least15 minutes of verification precede handoff. No source imports, WORD fetch/decompression/scan, NumPy/native execution, replay, fault campaign or kernel ran; no scientific VERIFY hook is registered.

## Credit

Credit Ali Romman #6546/#6547/#6532/#6509, zxv #6066, DreamingOfClouds #6030/P104, Cinna Davis and all retained NOTICE/native/compiler contributors. Chronological induction and pigeonhole/product counting are classical. ToikY used substantial OpenAI Codex assistance with separate abstract, code, metadata and byte roles. Source attribution/license is retained; no blind, human, proof-kernel acceptance or endorsement is claimed.

## Open next questions

Formalize the exact conditional certificate/capacity implication; separately bind the actual multiplication entrance and complete retained-state recovery/cleanup invoice before transferring it. Native/read-set/lifetime/shape premises, physical sampling/routing/restoration, the full supplier and all five selected assumptions remain open. See TASK for first steps and blockers. No κ/frontier/adoption change or merge; maintainer edits and auto-merge disabled.
